init.title: Record architecture decisions
init.problem: We need a consistent way to capture and communicate significant architectural decisions so future contributors (human or agent) can find the reasoning behind them.
init.option.none: No formal record, rely on commit messages and memory
init.option.adr: Architecture Decision Records stored alongside the code
init.decision: Architecture Decision Records stored alongside the code
init.rationale: they version with the code, stay close to what they describe, and are readable by both humans and coding agents
init.good: decisions and their rationale are discoverable in the repository itself
init.bad: requires discipline to keep records up to date as decisions evolve
init.confirmation: * [ ] `{adr_dir}` exists with this file, a template, and an index.
init.revisit: The team adopts a different documentation system project-wide.
